title: Minneapolis Rental Licenses (Landlords)
description: Active rental licenses in Minneapolis: address, licensed units, tier, license dates, short-term-rental flag, and the owner and applicant names and mailing addresses the city publishes. Filter by owner, neighborhood or unit count.
why: Every rental in Minneapolis must be licensed, so this is the city's own register of who owns rental property and how many units. Search an owner to see their whole portfolio.
useCases: Property managers, insurers and contractors finding landlords by portfolio size
Investors looking for owners of 2 to 4 unit buildings
Tenant groups and researchers mapping ownership

ownerName.title: Owner name contains
ownerName.description: e.g. LLC, or a company name

neighborhood.title: Neighborhood
neighborhood.description: Exact neighborhood name, e.g. Powderhorn Park

minUnits.title: Minimum licensed units
minUnits.description: Only licenses with at least this many units.

shortTermRentalOnly.title: Short-term rentals only
shortTermRentalOnly.description: Only licenses flagged as short-term rentals.

limits: Owner and applicant phone numbers and email addresses are deliberately omitted, even though the city file carries them.
